sentences.text:
1. The petitioners are before this Court seeking for the following reliefs:
a. Issue a writ, direction or order in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondents to pay the compensation amount as per award dated 28.2.2023 passed under section 28A of Land Acquisition Act at Annexure-A passed by the Assistant Commissioner, Kalaburagi.
b. Pass such other orders, as the petitioner is entitled to in the facts and circumstances of the case, in the interest of justice and equity.
2. The petitioners claim to be the owners of land bearing survey number 76, measuring 1 acre 38 guntas, situated at Tajsultanpur village, Kalaburagi District, which had been acquired by the State for formation of a railway line between Bidar and Kalaburagi.

Compensation having been fixed at NC: 2023:KHC-K:5506 Rs.1,72,000/- by award dated 9.07.2012 by respondent No.3, a reference having been made by third parties, the reference Court enhanced the market value in LAC Nos.
634/2013 and 639/2013 by award dated 16.04.2018.

3. Hence, the petitioner filed an application under section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act 1894 ['LA Act' for short] on 4.06.2018 for redetermination of compensation on the basis of the aforesaid award dated 16.04.2018.

Respondent No.3 having passed an additional award on 28.02.2023 has Ayyanna And Ors vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/85871224/
3 forwarded the same to respondent No.2 for approval.

sentences.text: It is aggrieved by the same the petitioners are before this court seeking for the aforesaid reliefs.

4. Sri.A.M.Nagaral, learned counsel for the petitioners by relying upon an order passed by the Co-ordinate Bench of this Court dated 11.09.2019 in W.P. No.103554/2013 and other connected matters submits that there is no requirement for approval of an award passed by the SLAO by the Deputy NC: 2023:KHC-K:5506 Commissioner and that the forwardal of the award to the Deputy Commissioner is bad in law and is required to be set-aside and respondent No.3 be directed to make payment of the compensation amount as per the award passed subject to any other grievance that the petitioners may have in relation thereto.

5. This court having categorically held by the aforesaid orders that no approval or permission from the Deputy Commissioner is required, respondent No.3 ought not to have forwarded the said award to the respondent No.2 for approval.
It is for respondent No.3 to have made payment of the amount in terms of the award passed.

The award being forward by respondent No.3 on 28.02.2023 subsequent to the order passed by this Court on 11.09.2019 W.P. No. 103554/2013, wherein this Court had reiterated the applicable law as regards the award passed under Section 28-A of the LA Act not requiring the approval NC: 2023:KHC-K:5506 of the Deputy Commissioner, respondent No.3 was required to follow the same.

6. In that view of the matter, I pass the following:
ORDER i.
The writ petition is allowed.
ii. Respondent No.3 is directed to release the amount awarded under the award within a period of four weeks from today.

iii. Respondent No.1 is directed to forward a copy of the order passed by this Court dated 11.09.2019 in W.P. No.103554/2013 and other connected matters to all the Special Land Acquisition Officers in the State, if necessary, a translated copy of the said judgment in Kannada also to be forwarded to all the Special Land Acquisition Officers in the State.
iv. Though disciplinary proceedings could be initiated against respondent No.3, this Court refrains from directing such an inquiry.
Though the above matter is disposed to report compliance of the above direction to Respondent No.1 relist on 18.08.2023 at 2.30 pm.
